payload._note: Revenue concentration refers to Women's Health portfolio representing 27% of total revenues in 2023. This filing is for Organon & Co. (ticker OGN), a women's health-focused pharmaceutical company spun off from Merck in June 2021. The company has a portfolio of 60+ medicines across women's health (contraception, fertility, postpartum hemorrhage, bacterial vaginosis), biosimilars (immunology and oncology), and established brands (cardiovascular, respiratory, dermatology). Key patents for Nexplanon rod technology expire 2027 in US and 2025 in other countries, with potential 3-year additional market exclusivity available but not assured. Company generated $6.3B in revenues in 2023 with 76% from international markets. Pipeline includes both proprietary assets and biosimilar candidates with various development partners. No FDA application numbers or specific Orange Book applicant names were disclosed in this filing. Total potential milestone payments of $1.9B relate to business development agreements as of December 31, 2023.
